output.decision: Keep ticket 103 waiting on a human. There are 8 of the 20 requested CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies in size M; the shortfall is 12, with an estimated restock cost of $264. Bulldog Print Co cannot ship while invoice 501 ($840) is unpaid, and the available $152 after commitments and the existing $8 PO request is $112 short of the restock cost. No PO or discount approval was filed. A $55-per-hoodie candidate would yield $660 gross margin (60%), but the price and full order cannot be confirmed now. Customer draft #8 is posted and has not been sent.
reasons: Inventory confirmed 8 size-M hoodies on hand and a 12-unit shortfall. Bulldog Print Co's lead time is 5 days after order placement, but shipment is blocked by open invoice 501; no delivery date can be promised before the vendor can ship and an order is placed.

On shop date 2026-08-31, checking holds $3,400; $840 is owed on an open invoice and $2,400 rent is due 2026-09-02, leaving $160 after those commitments. Existing pending PO #2 for $8 leaves $152 available, which is $112 below the $264 restock estimate. Cash only goes out, so future sales cannot cover the gap.

At the $58 list price, the 20-unit order would yield $720 gross margin (62.07%). The $55 candidate yields $660 gross margin (60%). Since stock and funding are not secured, accounting did not file a discount request; no discount is approved.

Customer service posted draft #8 explaining that only 8 units are currently in stock and that neither the full quantity nor a discount can be confirmed. It gives the 5-day lead time only conditionally, after a restock order is approved and placed, and is not sent.

Related pending approvals #1 (invoice 501) and #3 (rent) are on other tickets; pending PO #2 is also on ticket 101. None is an approval for ticket 103. Ticket 103 cannot be resolved because the customer's requested quantity and price remain unconfirmed.
human_actions_needed: Review and send customer draft #8 only if appropriate; otherwise revise it before sending.

Resolve the related pending commitments in light of their priorities: invoice payment approval #1 and rent payment approval #3, and account for pending PO #2. Approval alone is not proof of payment or execution.

After commitments are handled, make at least $112 more available for the $264 restock, then have inventory/accounting submit the required human-approved purchase order and discount request if the 20-unit offer is still wanted. Reconfirm availability and pricing before making an offer to Yale AI Club.
